summary: lightclient 对 EIP-8141 做了两项修改：允许 payer 先于 sender 批准，作为 guarantor 角色方案的更简替代；以及因已有 frame 批处理而移除默认账户的 RLP 调用批处理。前者误合并后被回滚并重新提交。ethresear.ch 提出借助 EIP-7702 与隐藏公钥的 ZK 证明，一笔交易把任何 EOA 升级到后量子安全。

items.title: EIP-8141：允许 payer 先于 sender 批准
items.note: （lightclient）提交并合并：作为 #11555 guarantor 角色的替代，作者认为直接允许 payer 先批准更简单；本应只建草稿，随即由 #11579 回滚（提交并合并），并以 #11580 重新提交。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: allow payer to approve before sender
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted and merged: an alternative to the #11555 guarantor role, which the author finds simpler; it was meant to be a draft, so #11579 reverted it (submitted and merged) and #11580 resubmitted it.

items.title: EIP-8141：移除默认账户的 RLP 调用批处理
items.note: （lightclient）提交并合并：有了 frame 批处理后，默认账户不再需要 RLP 调用批处理。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: remove the RLP call batch for the default account
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted and merged: with frame batching, the default account no longer needs RLP call batches.

items.title: EIP-8130：新增 opaque_input 字节字段
items.note: （pochenai）提交：在 AA 交易中恢复旧交易 input 字段承担的交易级元数据角色（如 ERC-8021 归因后缀），不参与 EVM 执行，但必须纳入 sender 与 payer 的签名哈希，防止中继或构建者替换。
items.title_en: EIP-8130: add an opaque_input bytes field
items.note_en: (pochenai), submitted: restores the transaction level metadata role of the legacy input field (such as ERC-8021 attribution suffixes) in AA transactions; it is not part of EVM execution but must be in both the sender and payer signature hashes so relayers and builders cannot swap it.

items.topic: 后量子：一笔交易升级 EOA
items.title: ethresear.ch：用 ZK 证明与隐藏公钥，一笔交易把任何以太坊钱包升级到后量子安全
items.note: 18:07：EOA 通过 EIP-7702 委托给只接受隐藏公钥下 ECDSA 知识 ZK 证明的合约，地址不变、无需迁移资产、无需共识改动，Apple M1 上证明 87 ms、验证 65 ms、证明 226 KB。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: upgrade any Ethereum wallet to post-quantum security in one transaction using ZK proofs with a hidden public key
items.note_en: 18:07: the EOA delegates via EIP-7702 to a contract that only accepts ZK proofs of ECDSA knowledge under a hidden public key, with no address change, no asset migration and no consensus change; 87 ms to prove, 65 ms to verify and a 226 KB proof on Apple M1.

summary_en: lightclient made two EIP-8141 changes: letting the payer approve before the sender, a simpler alternative to the guarantor role, and removing RLP call batches from the default account now that frame batching exists. The first was merged by accident, reverted and resubmitted. ethresear.ch proposed using EIP-7702 and ZK proofs under a hidden public key to upgrade any EOA to post-quantum security in one transaction.
